description: Case-file panel for the Sherlock OSINT triage skill. Public sources only; login-gated and PII requests are refused.

views.title: Case findings grid
views.pattern: MyMind/Raindrop-inspired card grid (studied docs only, no code copied): lane filter, search box, uniform cards, click opens detail.

sort.note: Fixed demo ordering: DEMO-CASE-001 ranks top-1 for query 'osint demo case'; within the case, high confidence first. Documented, not personalized.

states.empty: No findings match. Show empty state, never fake cards.
states.error: Show error state with reason; findings stay [].

views.title: Finding detail
views.trigger: open-detail from grid card (click or Enter)

props.focus: trap inside modal, restore focus to invoking card on close

exampleResult.orderingNote: Fixture rank: exact fixture-query match outranks all others. Only DEMO-CASE-001 matches 'osint demo case'; ordering is documented here and mirrored by the offline dashboard's embedded fixture ranking.

username.note: Multi-site corroboration upgrades the base low confidence to medium; a lone single-site hit would stay low.

reel.caption: open-source research notes: tracing public handles across demo sites for DEMO-CASE-001. Methods only, no private data.

transcriptStub.note: Stub data, honestly marked low confidence.

findings.value: open-source research notes: tracing public handles across demo sites for DEMO-CASE-001. Methods only, no private data.
